tracks.title: Security
tracks.tagline: Audit, break and harden systems — web, binaries, crypto and networks.

notes.cybersecurity: Piscine of short security modules (web scraping, OTP, onion service, reverse engineering…); validate the last module to count it.
notes.ft_ping: Recode ping against inetutils-2.0 (raw sockets, RTT).
notes.ft_ssl_md5: First of the ft_ssl series: plan the structure, later projects build on it.
notes.darkly: Audit a vulnerable website and document each finding.
notes.snow-crash: Eleven independent challenges on a vulnerable Linux VM.
notes.ft_traceroute: Recode traceroute (IPv4, --help only): follow a packet hop by hop. Needs ft_ping.
notes.ft_ssl_des: Second ft_ssl step: base64 and DES (ECB/CBC) built into your ft_ssl.
notes.boot2root: Get root on a provided practice VM in at least two different ways, and document each path.
notes.rainfall: Level-by-level binary-analysis challenges on a practice VM; keep everything that helped you in your repo. Needs snow-crash.
notes.ft_ssl_rsa: Third ft_ssl step: prime generation and RSA keys (genrsa, rsa, rsautl).
notes.override: Sequel to Rainfall on 64-bit binaries with modern protections — the hardest of the series.
notes.unleashthebox: Done on HackTheBox to reach a minimum rank — it can't be retried, prepare first.

tracks.title: Full-stack web
tracks.tagline: Ship complete web products: back end, front end, real-time and frameworks.
tracks.rncp: RNCP 6 — Web & mobile · RNCP 7 — Databases & Data

notes.camagru: Webcam photo-montage site from scratch (PHP/JS), users, gallery, likes — first web project.
notes.red-tetris: Introduction to full-stack JavaScript: multiplayer Tetris with React and a Node server.
notes.matcha: Dating site, any language/micro-framework: auth, profiles, matching, real-time chat.
notes.piscine-django: Django piscine: Python web framework basics to sessions and SQL; validate the last module to count it.
notes.h42n42: Browser game in OCaml with Ocsigen/Eliom (needs ft_turing).
notes.hypertube: Video streaming site over BitTorrent with an MVC framework.
notes.piscine-symfony: PHP Symfony piscine, same structure as the Django one.
notes.music-room: Connected collaborative mobile app with its own back end and social login — a real product.

tracks.title: Mobile
tracks.tagline: Native apps from first screen to a full product with its own API.

notes.mobile: Mobile piscine: six modules from first screen to auth and data; counts for both RNCP 6 titles.
notes.swifty-companion: Mobile intro with the 42 API, any stack (Flutter, Swift, Kotlin…).
notes.swifty-proteins: 3D molecule rendering, biometric login, data parsing.
notes.peace_break: Mobile brick-breaker with auth, shop, leaderboard and 10+ stages.
notes.music-room: Connected collaborative mobile app with its own back end and social login — a real product.

tracks.title: Java & enterprise back end
tracks.tagline: Object-oriented design, Spring, microservices and message queues.

notes.piscine-java: Java Modules 00–09; Module 09 (client/server sockets) unlocks the whole Java arc.
notes.piscine-object: OOP piscine: encapsulation, relationships, UML, SOLID, design patterns.
notes.avaj-launcher: Intro to Java: implement a given UML class diagram (weather simulation).
notes.swingy: Text RPG with MVC — switch between console and Swing GUI.
notes.fwa: First Java web app with servlets and authentication.
notes.spring-boot: Spring Boot MVP of your web app — needs Java Module 09 and Cinema; unlocks RESTful.
notes.restful: REST API with Spring (needs Spring Boot).
notes.ft_microservices: Microservices with Spring; unlocks Microshop and MessageQueue.
notes.messagequeue: Work with a large flow of tasks through RabbitMQ.
notes.microshop: Cloud-native e-commerce: Java/Micronaut microservices + front end + Docker.
notes.fix-me: Last Java project: multi-threaded networking with async sockets (FIX trading simulation).

tracks.title: Data science
tracks.tagline: From Python and SQL to analytics, recommendation and forecasting.

notes.python-for-data-science: Python piscine for data: arrays, data tables, OOP, data-oriented design (5 modules).
notes.piscine-data-science: Data science piscine: data engineering to analysis (needs Python for Data Science).
notes.datomic: SQL to columnar, key-value and graph across six engines in one VM (20 levels).
notes.churn: First neural-net project: fully-connected nets, back-propagation, dropout.
notes.myspotify: Recommender systems: top-N, content-based and collaborative filtering on music data.
notes.tweets-deprecated: First NLP project: vectorize tweets, similarity, sentiment classification. Registrable version ("tweet" is closed).
notes.understanding-customer: Intent classification with deep NLP (RNN, LSTM, Transformers) — subject assumes NLP + neural-net basics.
notes.uber: Demand forecasting for a taxi company: stationarity, smoothing, SARIMA.
notes.fried-eggs: Computer vision: labeling, CNN, detection and instance segmentation.

tracks.title: AI & machine learning
tracks.tagline: Models from scratch, deep learning, reinforcement learning and LLM systems.

notes.multilayer-perceptron: Build feedforward + backprop + gradient descent yourself; you must explain them — the base of the AI branch.
notes.total-perspective-vortex: EEG data with MNE: filtering, dimensionality reduction, scikit-learn pipeline, real-time classification.
notes.learn2slither: Reinforcement learning (Q-learning) on a 10×10 snake board.
notes.leaffliction: Computer vision on leaf images: dataset analysis, augmentation, classification.
notes.piscine-deep-learning: Deep-learning piscine modules (needs Piscine Data Science).
notes.call-me-maybe: Function calling: turn prompts into structured calls with typed arguments (constrained JSON output).
notes.rag-against-the-machine: RAG over a real codebase: chunking, BM25/TF-IDF retrieval, answers with a small local model, retrieval metrics. Builds on Call Me Maybe.
notes.n-puzzle: A* search with several heuristics; unlocks gomoku, expert-system, krpsim.
notes.gomoku: Min-max AI that must beat a human quickly.
notes.agent-smith: Agentic framework: Thought → Code → Observation loop solving coding challenges in a sandbox.
notes.inception-of-context: AI-native engineering: index your code in a vector DB, local LLM, validated automatic edits. Builds on Inception.
notes.inception-of-wisdom: Autonomous version of Inception of Context: observe a service, decide, patch, verify.

tracks.title: DevOps & cloud
tracks.tagline: Deploy, observe and run services: containers, Kubernetes, networks.

notes.cloud-1: Automated deployment of your Inception stack on a cloud server, one container per process.
notes.taskmaster: Job-control daemon like supervisor; any language, done in a VM.
notes.matt-daemon: A daemon on port 4242 with a logging class reused later.
notes.ft_ping: Recode ping against inetutils-2.0 (raw sockets, RTT).
notes.ft_traceroute: Recode traceroute (IPv4, --help only): follow a packet hop by hop. Needs ft_ping.
notes.ft_lgtm: Code playground (WASM/WASI) on Kubernetes with logs, metrics and traces (LGTM stack).
notes.bgp-at-doors-of-autonomous-systems-is-si: Extends NetPractice: GNS3 + Docker, VXLAN, then BGP EVPN — in that order.
notes.inception-of-context: AI-native engineering: index your code in a vector DB, local LLM, validated automatic edits. Builds on Inception.
notes.inception-of-wisdom: Autonomous version of Inception of Context: observe a service, decide, patch, verify.

tracks.title: Systems & kernel
tracks.tagline: Unix internals, memory, processes, then your own kernel.

notes.ft_ls: Opens the Unix branch: recode ls with -l -R -a -r -t.
notes.malloc: Recode malloc/free/realloc as a shared library.
notes.nm: Recode nm: read ELF sections and the symbol table.
notes.ft_select: Terminal UI with termcaps: navigate and select arguments with the arrow keys.
notes.lem-ipc: Processes communicating through System V IPC on a shared board.
notes.strace: Recode strace with ptrace (no options). Needs lem-ipc.
notes.ft_script: Recode script: pseudo-terminals and line discipline.
notes.42sh: Most complete and stable Unix shell possible: line editing, redirections, job control — team of 4–5.
notes.ft_linux: Build your own Linux distribution from source — base of the kernel branch.
notes.little-penguin-1: Eudyptula-style kernel tasks: custom kernel, modules, drivers. Needs ft_linux.
notes.process-and-memory: Add a custom syscall (get_pid_info) to the Linux kernel.
notes.drivers-and-interrupts: Write a keyboard driver for your Linux kernel. Needs ft_linux.
notes.kfs-1: Bootable kernel from scratch (C, C++ or Rust).
notes.kfs-2: Global Descriptor Table and a kernel-stack printer.
notes.filesystem: Write a filesystem kernel module (fortytwofs) with files, dirs and permissions.
notes.userspace_digressions: Write an init (PID 1): mount filesystems, start services, two advanced features.

tracks.title: Graphics & game dev
tracks.tagline: GPU rendering, physics, engines and complete games.

notes.scop: First GPU rendering project (OpenGL/Vulkan/Metal) — base of the graphics branch.
notes.unity: Unity piscine: 7 modules from physics to navmesh.
notes.nibbler: Snake in C++ where the graphics library is switched at runtime (dynamic libraries).
notes.humangl: Hierarchical modeling with a matrix stack (articulated humanoid).
notes.particle-system: GPU compute (OpenCL/CUDA/compute shaders) with a gravity point and shapes.
notes.shaderpixel: Fragment shaders: a museum scene of shader art pieces.
notes.in-the-shadows: Full Shadowmatic-like game in a game engine, menus and levels included.
notes.ft_newton: Physics engine: rigid bodies, collisions, torque — Angry Birds-like game.
notes.ft_vox: Deterministic procedural voxel world (≥16384×256×16384 cubes, ≥160-cube view distance) straight on OpenGL/Vulkan/Metal — performance-heavy; ft_minecraft builds on it.
notes.rt: Ray tracer: the mandatory part is worth 0, points come from the options.
notes.42run: Temple Run-style endless runner in OpenGL. Needs scop.
notes.mod1: Terrain from sparse points, then a water simulation on it.
notes.bomberman: A complete 3D game for real players: menus, saves, levels — team of 4–5.
notes.ft_minecraft: Continuation of ft_vox: biomes, caves, clouds and advanced lighting.
notes.very_real_engine: Build a reusable game engine library (scenes, rendering, physics).
notes.retroemu: Game Boy (DMG/CGB) emulator: CPU, debugger, from the hardware docs.

tracks.title: Algorithms & theory
tracks.tagline: Search, optimisation, math, automata and compilers.

notes.n-puzzle: A* search with several heuristics; unlocks gomoku, expert-system, krpsim.
notes.computorv2: First of the math series — essential for later projects.
notes.ready-set-boole: Boolean algebra and set theory exercises; unlocks ft_kleene.
notes.dr-quine: Quines (self-reproducing programs) in C and assembly — Kleene's recursion theorem.
notes.piscine-ocaml: OCaml piscine: functional basics to modules and monads; counts toward Functional.
notes.lem_in: Move n ants through a graph in the fewest turns (path finding + flow).
notes.rubik: Rubik's cube solver in as few moves as possible.
notes.ft_ality: First of the parsing series: train and run a finite-state automaton.
notes.expert-system: Propositional-logic inference engine (backward chaining). Needs n-puzzle, lem_in or rubik.
notes.krpsim: Optimise a process graph under resource constraints (team of 2–3).
notes.ft_kalman: Kalman filter tracking a vehicle from noisy sensors over UDP. Needs matrix.
notes.ft_kleene: Language theory literacy: Chomsky hierarchy and automata.
notes.b: B compiler with syntax-directed translation (no AST).
notes.ft_lex: Implement POSIX lex (automata, regex engine); leads to ft_yacc.
notes.ft_yacc: Implement POSIX yacc (pushdown automata); after ft_lex.
notes.cc1: C compiler that emits LLVM IR — needs ft_lex and ft_yacc.

tracks.title: Emerging tech
tracks.tagline: Web3, quantum computing and green IT.

notes.tokenizer: Create your own token on a blockchain (name must contain 42).
notes.tokenizeart: Create an NFT (must include 42) and its contract.
notes.tokenzwap: DeFi: an AMM smart contract with liquidity pools, swaps and a front end.
notes.ftl_quantum: Intro to quantum programs on a real quantum computer: superposition, entanglement, Deutsch-Jozsa, search.
notes.supercharge: Web app placing EV chargers on a real map: classical brute force vs a quantum QAOA solver.
notes.ecomesh: Keep a battery-powered sensor mesh alive for a year: carbon/energy cost model first.

tracks.title: Leadership & product
tracks.tagline: Lead a team over months, then run your own product.

notes.42sh: Most complete and stable Unix shell possible: line editing, redirections, job control — team of 4–5.
notes.music-room: Connected collaborative mobile app with its own back end and social login — a real product.
notes.open-project: Long-term team project (4–5 people, 6 months): specs, planning, delivery.
notes.startup-experience: Found and work full-time on your startup; counts as a full-time experience.
